offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry and thermal analysis instruments, with columns, consumables and software, sold to life science, pharmaceutical, food and environmental laboratories. Revenue comes from instrument sales, service contracts and software.

primary_products.value: liquid chromatography systems; mass spectrometers; chromatography columns; thermal analysis instruments; laboratory informatics software

primary_services.value: instrument maintenance and repair; calibration and qualification; training; software support

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, contract research labs, food and chemical testing companies; B2G: government and public research laboratories, regulatory testing agencies

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; food safety; environmental testing; academic research

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments, chromatography columns and consumables sold to laboratories; service fees: maintenance contracts, repairs and calibration services; subscription: laboratory software licenses and cloud subscriptions

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds its own instruments and columns, sold to laboratories and testing companies; software / platform: laboratory data software that customers use to run and manage instruments

geography_served.value: global: sells worldwide, with major operations in North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry and thermal analysis instruments, with columns and software, sharing laboratory customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: large pharmaceutical, biotech and government accounts served by its own sales teams; distributors / dealers: regional distributors covering smaller markets and countries; online: web store for columns and consumables

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: instruments used in regulated pharmaceutical quality testing must meet FDA and other good manufacturing practice and data integrity rules
